import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
py = str(repo / ".venv" / "bin" / "python")

for argv in [
    [py, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests/test_jobpipe_discovery.py"],
    [py, str(repo / "jobpipe.py"), "--help"],
    [py, str(repo / "jobpipe.py"), "jobs", "--limit", "1"],
]:
    run = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("$", " ".join(argv))
    print(run.stdout)
    print(run.stderr)
    if run.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(run.returncode)

print("jobpipe scout surface tests passed")
